line: They surgically removed - OR, surgeon over the sleeping patient
90% of her tongue - mouth model, tumour on the tongue
90% of her tongue - the front 90% lifts out, the stump stays
because it had cancer - the removed piece turns, purple tumour
they cut a muscle - her arm on the arm board, nurse at the arm
out of her arm - forearm model, muscle flap lifts out with its vessels
They connected - flap set onto the stump, vessels run to the neck
the veins inside her mouth - vessels join, stitches
and stitched the nerves - yellow nerve joins
(stitching) - surgeon's masked face, concentrating
The muscle was shaped - the slab starts to take the tongue's form
onto what was left of her tongue - shaping completes, colour turns tongue-pink
matching its shape - full mouth, new tongue
its shape - surgeon straightens up, patient resting
doctors said - ward wide, doctor at the bedside
she would never speak - doctor, slight head shake
just days later - daughter walks in through the door
she said hello - patient close: turns, smiles, says hello
to her daughter - daughter walks to the bedside
both faces, mother and daughter
